title: Cobblemon Tokai Construction Pack
description: This pack is for my friends and I to construct our Cobblemon Server.
body:
# ![Title card for the Amber & Charcoal project](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91a94990d585d5fe125993cc6230070930fb1046.png)
The Tokai Region is a land of coastal and montane wonders! Grand natural reserves abound to protect its unique and magnificent Pokémon habitats while skyscrapers tower over the rough coastal terrain. 

A pack designed for building a big multiplayer Cobblemon adventure!
# <center> <font color="#FF9C00">**Design Principles**</font> </center>
<center> <font color="#FAB49D">· · ─────── ·𖥸· ─────── · ·</font> </center>

**<center>This creative project focuses on 3 major points.</center>**
- Varied systems for traveling and exploration of vast natural landscapes and dense concrete jungles.
- Experiences with friends and Pokémon companions in RPG-style stories and community driven adventures.
- Simulation of processes found in nature and emphasizing the beauty of the world we live in by refelecting it in game elements.

  These principles are fulfilled by the content of the mod. Create and its add-ons are used for methods of travel, Some More Blocks for building exciting environments and cities. Project Atmosphere is used to simulate the weather of the real area of the world that Tokai draws inspiration from. Cobblemon and its add-ons are the core of the adventure, while Distant Horizons hammers in the wonder of the vistas. Speaking of, Vista and Open Parties and Claims connect the world with regionwide storytelling and personal customization of vehicles and ownership of secret bases. Performance mods lift the heavy burden of processing the adventure for everyone to experience!

# <center> <font color="#7585FF">**What to Expect**</font> </center>
<center> <font color="#A6BCFF">✦ . 　⁺ 　 . ✦ . 　⁺ 　 . ✦</font> </center>

- **Who is it for?**
This project is actively being developed. The included Tokai Region server link is not for any public use now but may be in the future. This pack as it currently stands is for team members and friends to join my server after being approved by me personally. 

- **What will it include?**
The pack will hopefully go on to include keybinds and aesthetic configs for the team.  I later hope to add my own mods, resourcepacks and datapacks for use in roleplay and adventure scenarios in the world. Future versions may swap or remove mods. Using this for a personal world and updating with the pack may result in losing things you've made! 

- **Who is involved?**
This pack is not affiliated with the Cobblemon team. This pack is not affiliated with The Pokémon Company. As of now it is a community art project.

- **May I join?**
A link to the discord for the construction of the region is located in the modpack links. You may join to follow the project and with a building resume I *might* consider adding more personel. As it stands, this pack and server are for my friends and myself. 

- **Can I use shaders?**
As it stands only one shaderpack works; Atmospheric Shaders, which uses Iris. Note that as of now it is incompatible with Distant Horizons, you can use one or the other but not both.
